## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: An audit whose auditor vendor equals the author vendor is refused, or...

The system SHALL ensure that an audit whose auditor vendor equals the author vendor is refused, or recorded as a degraded inline-fallback with the reason, and is never silently accepted.

#### Scenario: An audit whose auditor vendor equals the author vendor is refused, or...

WHEN `audit-decision-trails-cross-model-against-the-transcript` is implemented
THEN An audit whose auditor vendor equals the author vendor is refused, or recorded as a degraded inline-fallback with the reason, and is never silently accepted.

### Requirement: A validator rejects any ledger entry whose evidence is free text rather than...

The system SHALL ensure that a validator rejects any ledger entry whose evidence is free text rather than a resolvable transcript event id, commit SHA or file:line pointer.

#### Scenario: A validator rejects any ledger entry whose evidence is free text rather than...

WHEN `audit-decision-trails-cross-model-against-the-transcript` is implemented
THEN A validator rejects any ledger entry whose evidence is free text rather than a resolvable transcript event id, commit SHA or file:line pointer.

### Requirement: Given a fixture transcript containing a decision absent from the...

The system SHALL ensure that given a fixture transcript containing a decision absent from the session-log, the audit reports it as a missing-from-trail finding.

#### Scenario: Given a fixture transcript containing a decision absent from the...

WHEN `audit-decision-trails-cross-model-against-the-transcript` is implemented
THEN Given a fixture transcript containing a decision absent from the session-log, the audit reports it as a missing-from-trail finding.

### Requirement: The rendered ledger ends with an Attention section naming the reviewer model...

The system SHALL ensure that the rendered ledger ends with an Attention section naming the reviewer model and listing the entries to read first; the auditor model comes from archetypes.yaml tiers, with no hardcoded model ids, and any decision-choices schema additions are optional.

#### Scenario: The rendered ledger ends with an Attention section naming the reviewer model...

WHEN `audit-decision-trails-cross-model-against-the-transcript` is implemented
THEN The rendered ledger ends with an Attention section naming the reviewer model and listing the entries to read first; the auditor model comes from archetypes.yaml tiers, with no hardcoded model ids, and any decision-choices schema additions are optional.
